notes: Navigation zones for the route planner (official / unofficial routes) and the zone-violation check.
colour: blue = mandatory passage (a gate an official flight between the listed bodies must pass),
red  = forbidden (no route through it; entering it is an administrative violation),
green = preferred corridor (official routes follow it when it runs their way).
A violation is an administrative penalty (fine, record), never a collision.

primary->secondary distance from the primary). shape: sphere (anchor, radius_km) | capsule (anchor, anchor_b, radius_km).
